brand.name: Arka (FICTIONAL DEMO BRAND)
guidelines: This brand and all its claims are invented for testing the pipeline. Never deliver this ad commercially.
Show the product in everyday use, not in a studio

product.name: Arka Insulated Tumbler 600 ml
product.description: Double-wall stainless-steel tumbler with a flip-top lid and carry loop.
visual_identity: Cylindrical body that tapers slightly towards the base
Sage green matte finish (for this ad)
Small embossed 'ARKA' wordmark on the front, about one third from the top
White flip-top lid with a loop handle

verified_claims.claim: Keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours
verified_claims.source: SAMPLE: fictional internal test report AT-2026-01

verified_claims.claim: Leak-proof when the lid is closed and locked
verified_claims.source: SAMPLE: fictional internal test report AT-2026-02

prohibited_claims: 'Best', 'number one', or comparisons with named competitors

target_audience.description: Urban office workers and commuters aged 22–35 who carry iced coffee or water through a hot day
pain_points: Bags get wet from leaking bottles

campaign.objective: Awareness + click-through to the shop link
campaign.concept_direction: Authentic 'it actually works' creator moment, filmed on a phone

deliverable.visual_style: Natural smartphone selfie video, daylight, realistic, lightly handheld

mandatory_elements: Product visible within the first 2 seconds
Spoken CTA in the last 2 seconds
